items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Al Branch gave up this place, and Ralph Wheelock took it over.

ctx.x: And they'd come over on the -- that's when I started working for Old Man Brown. At twelve o'clock they were all standing outside. And by twelve fifteen, the place was loaded with just white people.

And the same thing happened with Kelly's, where Madison Reed and Eubie Blake worked. Same thing in those places. But they didn't go into places like the Bucket of Blood. And, later on, when Charley opened, he put them all, both of them in the shade. See, for awhile, Charley worked at the Boathouse, then he went with Billy Leadman and Mary Stafford, they had a regular crew. And Grace Jackson. And then he went down to Illinois Avenue to -- Al Branch had a place down there. Well, Al Branch gave up this place, and…
